description:
On-chain token holder distribution for a token: total on-chain holder count, top-10 concentration percentage and a concentration score. Nansen aggregates across chains, so pass the symbol only and do not pass a chain argument. Use it when the user asks how many wallets hold a token, about holder count, holder concentration, whale ownership or distribution risk.

[Access: pay 0.02 USDC via x402 (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header) OR authenticate with an API key. An x402-capable client will auto-pay; API-key clients pay nothing per call.]

symbol.description: Asset symbol, e.g. BTC or ETH.

name: get_token_holders
